tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in the web app, docs and emails.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sheets, menus, table rows sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, inputs, the inside of a run log.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on any surface.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and control outlines. 3:1 on surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps on surface and surface-raised. 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: GreenCI emerald. Logo, keycap faces, large brand fields, charts. Not for small text on white (use brand-ink).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Emerald text and icons: links, the ‘CI’ in running copy, passing labels on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft emerald fill: passing chips, selected rows, success toasts. Text on it uses brand-ink.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button and action-key fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and brand fills.

tokens.name: deck
tokens.usage: Charcoal of the physical deck and keycap bases. Same in both themes; use on-deck for content on it.

tokens.name: deck-lip
tokens.usage: The darker lip under a charcoal key or panel.

tokens.name: on-deck
tokens.usage: Text and icons on deck.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Failing checks. Always paired with the word ‘Failing’ or the cross icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: fail-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind failing chips, error banners and failed log lines. Text on it uses fail.

tokens.name: work
tokens.usage: In-progress agent work: diagnosing, repairing, verifying. Paired with a spinner or the stage name.

tokens.name: work-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind in-progress chips and the live run banner. Text on it uses work.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: Queued, waiting for approval, needs you. Paired with a clock icon or ‘Needs you’.

tokens.name: wait-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind waiting chips and approval banners. Text on it uses wait.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 on every surface.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Red to green, one key at a time.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headlines, email hero lines, empty-state titles.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Page titles in the app, card headlines on promo.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: GreenCI found the cause and opened a fix PR.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; table key columns.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase key legends, chip text, section eyebrows.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Logs, CLI, inline code, commit SHAs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, chip inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, button icon gaps, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a page, desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections, email section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inline code, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sheets. Echoes the keycap corner (13/64 of the key).

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keycaps and app icons: the corner is always a fifth of the key's width.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and pill toggles only.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: The keycap lip on primary buttons and action keys. Drops to -1px when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: toasts, menus, dialogs, the mobile sheet.
